[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#00ff00]This mod replaces the vanilla fairy sprites in the Fairy Box Trinket with cuter and more detailed sprites.[/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]
I'm playing my current save with a fairy aesthetic and realized I wanted cuter and slightly more detailed sprites for the fairy box fairies, so I figured I'd share them with you guys as well. [/color][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Sorry for the same face syndrome here. It's easier to keep the same face and hairstyle when working with a limited pixel count and height and width count. The hair works well with the wings and helps create the illusion of the fairies having a body, so I kept it long for all of them. I wanted to make short hair fairies too :([/size][/color]

[quote][b][size=3]Fairies are numbered from left to right in the thumbnail starting with the first fairy with ginger/orange hair and continuing in a horizontal row[/size][/b][/quote]
[quote][color=#D4D4D8][size=3][b]Warning! [/b]There is a risk of something going wrong with your game when "...changing your unique multiplayer ID mid game or choosing the specific number combination if any, it could just be benign and affect multiplayer gubbins such as cabin choice and fairy skin." - Deleted Reddit User[/size][/color][/quote]
[size=4][b]Change Fairy Styles (Credit to a deleted Reddit user for their [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/StardewValley/comments/1cach8h/how_to_change_spoiler_spoiler_skin_warning_164/]post [/url]on this)[/b][/size]
[left]Guide is for Windows pc users[/left]
[list]
[*]Press Win+ R and type in %appdata% into the pop up window and select ok[/*]
[*]Open StardewValley and go into the Saves folder[/*]
[*]Go into your "farmname_id" folder example: Joja_370580095[/*]
[*]Right click your "farmname_id" save and open it with notepad[/*]
[*]Press ctrl + f and type multiplayer, it will take you to: <UniqueMultiplayerID>5336205887356168600</UniqueMultiplayerID> (this is the unique ID on the Reddit user's joja save)[/*]
[*]The number inside there is what you are changing[/*]
[*]So If you want the "evil" 7th fairy
Change: <UniqueMultiplayerID>5336205887356168600</UniqueMultiplayerID>
To: <UniqueMultiplayerID>-370763259255026343</UniqueMultiplayerID> Save it and done! reload your save[/*]
